title.narrative: Improved capacity of labour administration authorities, supported by the social partners, to implement and enforce core labour standards and all GLS, OSHS and social and welfare legislations, and to eliminate all forms of unacceptable work.

description.narrative:
PHL135 strengthens labour administration systems and promotes decent working conditions through improved enforcement of labour standards, enhanced occupational safety and health (OSH), and the elimination of child labour. It supports the Labour and Employment Plan (LEP) 2023–2028’s priority on labour market governance and priority on inclusive social protection. It also contributes to the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2024–2028’s priority on sustainable economic development and decent work, by reinforcing institutional capacity to uphold a rights-based and inclusive labour environment.
The initiative benefits workers, employers, and labour administration institutions by closing compliance gaps, improving dispute resolution, and strengthening the elimination and prevention of child labour. It builds on support to national child labour initiatives, including the Philippine Program Against Child Labour and SHIELD (Strategic Helpdesk for Information, Education, Livelihood and other Developmental Interventions) Against Child Labour, while expanding advisory visits to micro and small enterprises to improve adherence to labour standards and OSH regulations.
The strategy is implemented with government institutions, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and community partners to deliver stronger capacity for labour inspectors, inspectorate managers, conciliators, arbitrators and other officials; improved strategic compliance planning and OSH policy frameworks; policy advice on wage-setting, including minimum wages and living wages; and coordinated national and local actions to prevent and eliminate child labour.
By fostering effective enforcement, improved workplace safety and child labour-free supply chains, PHL 135 supports more resilient labour administration systems and decent work outcomes nationwide.
